Name: Clotted Shield (Light)
Description:
A shield that guards against enemy attacks and reduces damage. In exchange, guarding consumes stamina.

Perfectly blocking enemy attacks reduces stamina consumption.

Equipping it slightly increases base defense.

Description:

Name: Shield of Stupor
Description:
A shield that guards against enemy attacks and reduces damage. In exchange, guarding consumes stamina.

Perfectly blocking enemy attacks reduces stamina consumption, as well as produces a field that applies the stone status effect.

Equipping it slightly increases base defense.

Name: Mutinous Bracer
Description:
A bracer that can parry enemy attacks.

Respond to an incoming attack with a well-timed parry to deflect it and break the enemy's stance.

Successful parries consume ichor. They break the enemy's stance even if you have insufficient ichor but deal damage to the player.

Some attacks cannot be parried; these will instead be blocked.

Equipping it increases basic defense.

Name: Mutinous Bracer (Heavy)
Description:
A bracer that can parry enemy attacks.

Parry in time with an incoming attack to deflect it and break the enemy's stance.

Successful parries consume ichor. They break the enemy's stance even if you have insufficient ichor but deal damage to the player.

Some attacks cannot be parried; these will instead be blocked.

Equipping it greatly increases basic defense.

Name: Vanishing Hollow (Light)
Description:
A forma which allows the user to leap up vertically on the spot.

Nullifies enemy attacks during the ascent. After ascending, various midair actions can be performed. Equipping it slightly increases base defense.

Name: Umbral Shift
Description:
An evasive forma that enables quick stepping.

Activate it while holding in any direction to step. Equipping it slightly increases base defense.

Name: Dodge Spin (Light)
Description:
An evasive forma that enables quick short-range movement to avoid attacks.

Activate it while holding any direction to perform a short step. Equipping it slightly increases base defense.
